item.title: 治安警揭氹仔桑拿場操縱賣淫拘4負責人 20按摩女認提供性服務
item.description:
>
澳門治安警搗破桑拿賣淫案，帶走45人返署調查。 為配合國慶與中秋佳節前的治安淨化工作，澳門治安警察局近日持續加強打擊非法工作及賣淫等違規行為。在本周三(23日)的聯合巡查行動中，治安警聯同澳門勞工局成功揭發氹仔區一間桑拿場所有人涉及非法工作及操縱賣淫，帶走4名本地負責人及41名報稱從事按摩與清潔工作的女子返警局協助調查。 被帶走的41名女子中，經核實共有38人涉嫌違規工作，年齡介乎20至50歲。該群違規勞工背景複雜，包括27名黑工及11名家傭、按摩員和侍應等過界工作者，國籍涵蓋泰國、坦桑尼亞、南韓、俄羅斯、越南、緬甸、印尼及內地等地。其中有20人已在盤問中承認曾於場所內提供性服務，執法人員亦在現場檢獲一批安全套及潤滑劑等懷疑與賣淫相關的證物。 警方初步調查顯示，桑拿場所自今年5月份開始運作至今，對外收費大約介乎2,500至6,000澳門元不等。面對警方的調查，4名涉案負責人採取不合作的態度。目前，警方已將涉嫌操縱賣淫的刑事部分正式立案並移送檢察院偵辦，至於違反勞動關係法的過界及黑工部分則移交澳門勞工事務局跟進。

item.title: 澳娛綜合義工團隊中秋送暖 向2600弱勢基層派福包獻關愛
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合開展中秋送暖大行動，惠及約2,600人。 澳娛綜合為迎接中秋佳節，於本月1日至24日開展「澳娛綜合中秋送暖大行動」系列活動，動員近百人次的義工團隊深入全澳多個社福機構及弱勢群體，合共探訪850戶家庭，向約2,600名受惠人士送上福包與節日祝福，傳遞佳節歡欣與社會關愛，切實發揚守望相助的優良傳統。 澳娛綜合秉持「取諸社會、用諸社會」的宗旨，多年來心繫社區，是次探訪對象涵蓋兒童、青少年、特殊需要人士及長者等多元群體。受惠機構包括澳門防止虐待兒童會護兒中心、澳門唐心兒協會、澳門特殊奧運會、澳門九澳聖若瑟學校、澳門聽障人士協進會，以及多戶獨居長者、單親家庭及貧困家庭等，傾聽基層心聲，將企業關懷落實到社區之中。 除了派發福包，義工團隊更積極推動青銀共融。例如與澳門仁慈堂持續合辦「我和我的老友記」長者友誼計劃，9月份特設中秋主題，澳娛綜合義工隊走進仁慈堂安老院與長者一同製作中秋特色手工藝品並進行趣味猜謎，讓長者在歡聲笑語中感受濃厚傳統節慶氛圍。此外，澳娛綜合亦於本月13日攜手澳門明愛的青少年前往伯大尼安老院探訪，帶來精彩的音樂表演與互動遊戲，讓長者在悠揚旋律與歡笑聲中歡度佳節。 澳娛綜合表示，未來將繼續透過各類社區關懷活動踐行企業社會責任，積極關愛社會不同群體，合力建設青銀共融、友愛同行的和諧社區。

item.title: 國慶黃金周受惠盛事帶動 業界料日均訪澳旅客達12萬人次
item.description: https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/9月25日-黃金周預測.mp4 十一國慶黃金周假期將至，澳門旅遊、餐飲及零售業再度迎來傳統消費旺季。綜合旅遊業界與學術界預測，今年黃金周期間日均訪澳旅客料達12 萬人次。儘管受旅客消費模式轉型影響，人均消費呈放緩趨勢，但龐大的客流與盛事活動疊加，仍將成為拉動澳門全年經濟復甦及完成財政稅收目標的關鍵動力。 澳門旅遊業議會會長胡景光受訪時表示，在各項大型盛事與中央多項惠澳政策的疊加效應下，假期日均客量達12萬人次預期樂觀，全年總訪澳客量更有望衝擊4,300萬至4,400萬人次。胡景光分析，目前旅客消費模式已深度轉向自由行及深度體驗遊，客群仍以家庭及年輕人為主，消費意願依然強勁。在社區經濟方面，雖然澳門政府透過休遊巴士等措施帶動人潮入區，但社區中小企仍需主動轉型，推出如特色茶飲、精品咖啡等差異化產品，才能有效吸引年輕消費族群。 至於市場關注的酒店房價問題，胡景光指近年澳門酒店房間供應量較疫情前增加兩至三成，黃金周期間路氹區酒店房價預計維持在4,000至5,000元，澳門半島則約1,000至2,000元。整體房價趨於平穩理性，擺脫過往「海鮮價」形象，反而能有效降低旅客留宿成本，吸引更多旅客延長在澳門的逗留時間。 澳門理工大學博彩旅遊教學及研究中心教授曾忠祿分析，預期今個黃金周訪澳總旅客量將超過去年同期的350萬人次，料達370萬人次或更高。然而受限於旅客人均消費下降，預計10月份博彩毛收入約落在230億至240億澳門元之間，與去年同期基本持平或略有下調。 曾忠祿補充指雖然博彩收入增幅放緩，但順利完成政府全年預算目標並無懸念。澳門政府今年博彩毛收入預算目標為2,360億澳門元，截至目前已完成逾七成，後續財政壓力相對有限。 針對近年來「高客量、低消費」的結構性現象，曾忠祿強調，這反映出澳門客源結構正歷經深層次轉型。疫情以來，過往的豪賭客大幅減少，取而代之是家庭客以及55歲以上的年長客群(佔整體客量約28%)。這類客群消費模式相對理性，雖令賭收爆炸性增長不再，但也大幅降低問題賭博的風險，反而令澳門整體經濟與博彩業發展更具韌性、更趨健康及可持續。 隨着口岸疏導機制、旅遊巴士調配及各項非博彩盛事活動陸續到位，澳門旅遊及博彩業界已全面就位。今年國慶黃金周不僅是檢驗澳門旅遊承載力與服務質素的「試金石」，更是觀察澳門「1+4」經濟適度多元化進程的重要指標。業界普遍期望，在濃厚的節慶氣氛加持下，黃金周的高峰客流能進一步滲透社區，實現綜合旅遊休閒企業與社區中小企的雙贏發展，為澳門經濟持續回升向好注入強勁動能。

item.title: Macau’s Daily Visitor Arrivals Expected to hit 120,000 during Golden Week
item.description:
>
With the October National Day Golden Week holiday approaching, Macau’s tourism, dining, and retail sectors are once again welcoming a traditional peak consumption season. Combining forecasts from the tourism industry and academia, the daily average number of visitor arrivals to Macau during this year’s Golden Week is expected to reach 120,000.   The massive influx of visitors combined with major events will remain a key driving force to stimulate Macau’s annual economic recovery and achieve its fiscal tax revenue targets.   In an interview, Andy Wu, President of the Travel Industry Council of Macau, stated that under the synergistic effects of various major events and multiple favorable policies introduced by the central government, the expectation of a daily average of 120,000 visitors during the holiday is optimistic. Total annual visitor arrivals to Macau are even expected to challenge 43 million to 44 million. Wu analyzed that visitor consumption patterns have deeply shifted toward independent travel and immersive experiences, with the demographic remaining primarily families and young people whose willingness to spend remains robust. Regarding the community economy, although the government is driving visitor traffic into local neighborhoods through measures such as tour shuttle buses, community SMEs still need to proactively transform by introducing differentiated products such as specialty tea drinks and boutique coffee to effectively attract young consumer groups.   Regarding the market’s focus on hotel room rates, Wu pointed out that Macau’s hotel room supply has increased by 20% to 30% compared to pre-pandemic levels. During Golden Week, hotel room rates in the Cotai area are expected to remain between MOP 4,000 and MOP 5,000, while those on the Macau Peninsula will be around MOP 1,000 to MOP 2,000. Overall room rates are tending to be stable and rational, moving away from the past image of fluctuating “catch-as-catch-can” pricing, which instead effectively lowers overnight costs for travelers and encourages them to extend their stay in Macau.   Zeng Zhonglu, President of Asia Pacific Association for Gambling Studies (APAGS), analyzed that the total number of visitor arrivals to Macau this Golden Week is expected to exceed the 3.5 million from the same period last year, reaching 3.7 million or higher. However, constrained by a decline in per capita spending, gross gaming revenue for October is projected to land between MOP 23 billion and MOP 24 billion, remaining largely flat compared to the same period last year or showing a slight adjustment downward.   Zeng added that although the growth rate of gaming revenue has slowed, successfully meeting the government’s annual budget target is beyond doubt. The SAR government’s gross gaming revenue budget target for this year is MOP 236 billion, and over 70% of it has already been achieved to date, leaving subsequent fiscal pressure relatively limited.   Addressing the structural phenomenon of high visitor volume and low spending in recent years, Zeng emphasized that this reflects a profound transformation in Macau’s source market structure. Since the pandemic, traditional high-rollers have decreased significantly, replaced by family travelers and older demographics aged 55 and above (accounting for about 28% of total visitors). While this consumer group’s spending pattern is relatively rational, meaning explosive growth in gaming revenue is a thing of the past, it also substantially lowers the risk of problem gambling, making Macau’s overall economic and gaming industry development more resilient, healthier, and sustainable.   This year’s National Day Golden Week is not only a touchstone for testing Macau’s tourism carrying capacity and service quality, but also an important indicator for observing the progress of Macau’s 1+4 adequate economic diversification. The industry generally expects that, enhanced by a strong festive atmosphere, the peak visitor traffic during Golden Week will further penetrate local communities, achieving a win-win development for integrated tourism and leisure enterprises alongside community SMEs, and injecting strong momentum into Macau’s continuous economic recovery and upward trend.
